Markets rally as tech leads the way

By Jane Doe, May 1 2024

Global stock markets climbed on Wednesday as technology shares led a broad-based rally, with investors shrugging off fresh data on inflation and instead focusing on strong corporate earnings from the sector's biggest names.

The S&P 500 rose 1.2 percent, while the Nasdaq composite gained 1.8 percent, its best session in three weeks. Analysts said the move reflected renewed confidence that interest rates have peaked.

"The earnings season has been remarkably strong," said one strategist at a large bank.

European markets followed suit, with the Stoxx 600 up 0.9 percent in afternoon trading. Bond yields eased across the curve as traders pared back bets on further tightening.

Commodity markets were mixed, with oil steady and gold hitting another record high as central banks continued to buy.
